note: Recorded by hand from data/pages/config__latest__developerguide__managing-rules-by-region-availability.md before the parser was written. The page has 39 level-2 headings: 38 named '<Region> Region' and a trailing 'See also'. Each Region also carries one level-3 heading repeating the Region name; the level-3 headings were ignored so no Region is counted twice. Region sections were listed with `grep -n '^## '`, and the managed rules in each were counted with awk over lines matching '^+ [' inside each level-2 block, giving 21391 rule lines in total and 822 distinct rule names across the page. Managed rules are 822 instances of one thing, so they are never the numerator: the numerator is the 38 Regions. Rule counts per Region: US East (Ohio) 754, US East (N. Virginia) 814, US West (N.
